CompleteTableSemanticCoverage.description:
Locally-derived proof that one composition Fact covers one full table.

The model selects only child anchor spans. This record is assembled from
the immutable structured table after selection, so it cannot be fabricated
by a relay response or confused with an OCR reconstruction.

ContinuationBinding.description:
A non-destructive link from a page-end marker to an adjacent source page.

A closed binding is an input-side proof only. A model still has to select
the source and closure anchor spans before its ``all_items`` Fact may pass.
Manual bindings retain missing or ambiguous cases without granting that
publication permission.
